reference.coordinateConvention: Normalized viewport coordinates x,y,width,height; page rotation already applied.
limitations: Coarse room extents, not exact expert-reviewed segmentation.
Cubicle extents may include adjacent strips, so small localization differences require visual review.
Room 9 has a nonrectangular footprint and two cubicle holes; a bbox alone cannot represent it accurately.
Small equipment, gates and drinking systems have no complete reference annotations and are not inferred to be correct from this fixture.
One document cannot establish general performance; use held-out documents for model and method decisions.
